method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (fhog-core.l4, with six regulative rules for the duties of the applicant and the commissioner) and a seat layer (fhog-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a transaction that commenced before 20 November 2023, or an amount only an undeposited version of the Act could give, answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: First Home Owner Grant and Other Home Owner Grants Act 2000 (Qld) (act-2000-014), the version in force from 1 July 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2000-014.txt (retrieved 2026-10-20); with the First Home Owner Grant and Other Home Owner Grants Regulation 2021 (sl-2021-0018), the version in force from 19 March 2021, as deposited at ../../../first-home-owner-grant-and-other-home-owner-grants-regulation-2021/registers/source-bundle/sl-2021-0018.txt: rr 2, 3, 4 and 6. Section 91 makes the pre-1 July 2026 version (not deposited) govern earlier transactions; Part 3 Division 7 is applied as deposited to 20 November 2023 to 30 June 2026 (a reading).
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is the State of Queensland's under CC BY 4.0, with the attribution in SOURCE-LICENSE.md (Act) and ../../../first-home-owner-grant-and-other-home-owner-grants-regulation-2021/SOURCE-LICENSE.md (Regulation)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fhog-core.l4 ; l4 run fhog-seat.l4 ; l4 run fhog-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 160 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 10 #TRACEs with an expect line (5 breaches by the applicant, 4 obligations pending, 1 late objection owing nothing), each read and as expected; a control copy with one expected value altered was reported as failing
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the first home buyer: Part 2 Division 2 (s 4; s 5 with the $750,000 caps of s 5(6)-(9) and the s 5(4), (5) scheme presumption as facts; s 6; s 7; s 8 with Regulation r 2; s 8A as a stated value; s 9); Part 3 (s 10; ss 11-15, criteria 1-5, with the commissioner's approvals and exemptions as facts; s 16; s 17 with Regulation r 3; s 20; ss 25EA, 25EB; ss 22, 22A, 23 as regulative rules); Part 4 Division 3 (s 47 as a regulative rule with its penalty caps; s 48(2)-(5) with Regulation r 4; s 49, the release as a regulative rule); Regulation r 6 (completion); Part 5 (ss 56-59, objection and QCAT review, as a regulative rule). Out: Parts 3A and 3B (directions not deposited); Part 3 Divisions 5 and 6; ss 18, 24, 25; Part 4 Divisions 1, 2 and 4 and ss 49A-51A; s 69A beyond a fact; s 69B; Part 6 machinery; transitional Parts 7-16 except as they mark coverage (ss 79-81, 91). Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991 (s 8(8)(ha) excludes the grant from income; s 1118(1)(a), (b) the principal home) and subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997 (nothing stated about the grant); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
